A short quest in the Edron Troll Cave, west of the city. Leave through the castle sewer, cross the cave to the grass area, go down to the troll cave and open the two boxes on the last floor to receive some {item:Brass Legs} and a {item:Garlic Necklace}.
Sewer in the southwest corner of Edron castle

If nobody has been there for a while, you may find up to 20 {creature:Troll Champion|Troll Champions}. At low levels, advance slowly and take advantage of the narrow passage where only one Troll Champion can attack you at a time.
On the way you only meet {creature:Rat|Rats}; {creature:Bug|Bugs}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Goblin|Goblins} only show up if you stray too far.

Travel to **Edron** by boat (at your city's harbour, {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}). From the **Edron** depot, go down the sewer in the **southwest** corner of the castle.
There is only one path: follow the cave, going down and up, until you come out in a grassy area.
Go to the Troll Cave to the **northwest** and go down the hole.
Get ready to face up to 20 {creature:Troll Champion|Troll Champions} if nobody has passed through for a while.
Follow this path **north** and **east** and go down the hole.
Follow the path to the room in the **north** and go down the hole.

Here you face several {creature:Troll|Trolls}, {creature:Bear|Bears}, {creature:Troll Champion|Troll Champions} and a {creature:Frost Troll}. The reward is in **two boxes** on the **east** side of the room. Open both.
Last floor with the two boxes in the east

Go back the same way: on each floor return to the hole you came down through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up, until you come out in the grassy area. From there cross the cave again to the **southeast**, to the **Edron** castle sewer.
